items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: I signed a contract and I was with the Whiteman band from Spring of ‘36 until he died... Benny Bonacchio is going to leave the Whiteman band... Benny took Chet Haslett’s place

ctx.x: Well, Ernie, a sax player, came to me at WINS when WINS, oh, all the networks had live music. Six piece band, eight piece band, forty, whatever. He comes to me and he says, “You know, Al, Benny Bonacchio is going to leave the Whiteman band.” Benny took Chet Haslett’s place, and he’s going to need a first alto player.” I says, “You’ve got to be kidding.” He says, “No, go see him.” So he made an appointment and I went to see him up in Studio 3A, third floor of NBC. This is early 1936. So Paul Whiteman greeted me…
Isn’t that interesting. You see the difference in the ages right there.
